questions.s:
Iron rusts easily, hence steel structures should be treated to slow down the rusting process.
Which row incorrectly describes how each method protects iron from rusting and its main disadvantage?
o: method: painting steel; how it protects: provides a barrier between the iron and the atmosphere; disadvantage: paint scrapes off easily, exposing iron to the atmosphere

method: alloying steel with chromium to make stainless steel; how it protects: chromium reacts with oxygen in the air to form a barrier of chromium oxide which prevents iron from rusting; disadvantage: production of stainless steel is costly
method: storing steel objects in a dry place; how it protects: absence of water prevents iron from rusting quickly; disadvantage: difficult to keep storage place dry at all times

method: coating steel plates with zinc; how it protects: zinc is more reactive than iron, and provides a barrier between iron and the atmosphere; disadvantage: when coating of zinc is scratched, iron will corrode in place of zinc, making it rust more quickly
